text: Three studies report mouse genetic models. mGluR6 knockout mice, exploiting the receptor's restricted expression in retinal ON bipolar cells, lost ON responses to light while OFF responses remained unchanged; retinal organization and optic fiber projections to the brain were normal, and mutant mice still showed visual behavioral responses in shuttle box avoidance experiments, indicating mGluR6 is essential for synaptic transmission to ON bipolar cells and the OFF pathway carries important visual information. A conditional p75(NTR) allele (p75(NTR-FX)) flanking Exons 4-6, encoding transmembrane and cytoplasmic domains, with loxP sites was validated via neural crest-specific p75(NTR)/Wnt1-Cre and conventional null mutants, both showing abnormal hind limb reflexes and peripheral neuropathy. Nrg1 and ErbB4 signalling cell-autonomously controls development of cortical GABA interneuron connectivity, contradicting the prevailing excitatory-synapse view.
